key_debates.title: Is supplier-financed negative working capital durable? / 供应商融资支持的负营运资金是否可持续？
key_debates.market_view: High payables relative to inventory and long supplier terms support cash conversion, but a normalization of terms could absorb substantial cash. / 高应付账款与较长供应商账期支撑现金转化，但若条款正常化，可能显著占用现金。
key_debates.alternative_view: Scale, purchasing relevance and inventory productivity may preserve favorable terms while commercial growth supports turnover. / 规模、采购重要性及库存效率可能维持有利条款，商业客户增长也可支持周转。
key_debates.missing_evidence: Supplier-program concentration, remaining payment-term distribution, vendor-renewal behavior and an eight-quarter comparable CCC bridge. / 尚缺供应商计划集中度、剩余付款条款分布、供应商续约行为及八季度可比CCC桥接。
key_debates.resolution_kpi_or_event: Accounts-payable-to-inventory remains near the disclosed level while inventory growth does not materially exceed sales growth and FCF underwriting base is at least USD 1.94 billion. / 应付账款占库存比例维持在披露水平附近、库存增速不显著高于销售增速，且FCF分析基准至少19.4亿美元。

key_debates.title: Will growth capex create enough incremental cash return? / 增长性资本开支能否产生足够的增量现金回报？

key_debates.alternative_view: New stores and double-digit domestic commercial growth can expand future cash generation if inventory and operating expenses scale efficiently. / 若库存和经营费用实现规模效率，新门店及美国商业客户双位数增长可扩大未来现金流。
key_debates.missing_evidence: Mature-store cohort returns, maintenance-versus-growth capex, and incremental commercial working-capital requirements. / 尚缺成熟门店批次回报、维持性与增长性资本开支拆分，以及商业客户业务的增量营运资金需求。
key_debates.resolution_kpi_or_event: LTM FCF rises above USD 1.94 billion while sales growth remains positive and capex growth does not outrun the evidenced return path. / LTM FCF升至19.4亿美元以上，同时销售保持增长，资本开支增长不超过已验证的回报路径。
key_debates.decision_impact: The answer determines whether the current multiple reflects productive reinvestment or over-capitalized growth. / 该问题决定当前倍数反映的是高效再投资，还是资本投入过多的增长。

key_debates.market_view: Consensus expects continued earnings growth and a target above the dated price, but trailing P/FCF is near 29.7x and buybacks continue alongside substantial debt. / 一致预期仍看好盈利增长且目标价高于当前时点价格，但历史P/FCF接近29.7倍，公司在高债务背景下仍持续回购。
key_debates.alternative_view: Per-share compounding can remain attractive if FCF grows into the valuation and refinancing remains non-binding. / 若FCF增长能够消化估值且再融资不构成约束，每股复合增长仍可能具有吸引力。

fcf_underwriting_base.normalization_scope: Reported LTM CFO less reported cash capex retained as a public-data underwriting base; no economic normalization adjustment is applied. / 保留报告LTM CFO减报告现金资本开支作为公开数据分析基准，未进行经济标准化调整。
fcf_underwriting_base.no_adjustments_rationale: Reported LTM CFO less reported cash capex is retained because no audited basis was found to split maintenance from growth capex or normalize supplier-financing working capital without inventing assumptions. Cash interest, cash taxes, working capital and operating lease cash flows already embedded in CFO are not deducted again. / 保留报告LTM CFO减报告现金资本开支的结果，因为缺乏经审计依据拆分维持性与增长性资本开支，也不能在不虚构假设的情况下标准化供应商融资营运资金。CFO中已包含的现金利息、现金税、营运资金及经营租赁现金流不再重复扣除。

what_is_priced_in.conditional_conclusion: At the analyst-owned 25x sensitivity reference, the dated market capitalization requires approximately USD 1,939.824 million of FCF, 18.8% above the Public-Data FCF Underwriting Base of USD 1,633.222 million; the dated price requires operating and cash-flow improvement beyond the public-data base. This conclusion is conditional on the selected reference multiple and is not a fair-value claim. / 按分析师设定的25倍敏感性参考，时点市值要求约19.398亿元FCF，较16.332亿元的公开数据FCF分析基准高出18.8%；时点价格要求经营与现金流改善超过公开数据基准。该结论取决于所选参考倍数，并非公允价值判断。
what_is_priced_in.risk_interpretation: The conditional FCF requirement must be tested against supplier-payment terms, inventory productivity, returns on elevated capex, debt-funded repurchases, management guidance, and operating evidence. Price momentum or a 52-week range position is not treated as priced-in evidence. / 条件性FCF要求必须结合供应商付款条件、库存效率、较高资本开支回报、债务融资回购、管理层指引及经营证据检验；价格动量或52周区间位置不作为已定价证据。
